INSERT INTO approval_tokens (
  session_id, token, action_type, action_summary,
  full_data, staff_email, expires_at
) VALUES (
  '{{ $json.session_id }}',
  '{{ $json.token }}',
  '{{ $json.action_type }}',
  '{{ ($json.approval_summary || '').replace(/'/g, "''") }}',
  '{{ JSON.stringify($json.full_data || {}).replace(/'/g, "''") }}'::jsonb,
  '{{ $json.staff_email }}',
  '{{ $json.expires_at }}'
)
RETURNING id

UPDATE approval_tokens SET
  status = CASE WHEN '{{ $json.decision }}' = 'approve' THEN 'approved' ELSE 'rejected' END,
  responded_at = NOW()
WHERE token = '{{ $json.token }}';

UPDATE sessions SET
  status = CASE WHEN '{{ $json.decision }}' = 'approve' THEN 'approved' ELSE 'rejected' END,
  updated_at = NOW()
WHERE id = '{{ $json.session_id }}'
